flows.title: Create a project
steps: Click your organization's icon in the top left navigation and select Projects from the menu.
Choose the platform, the language or framework the project uses, and set the alert frequency.
Name the project in the Project name field and assign a team in the Team dropdown.
Click Create Project. Sentry opens the setup guide for that platform's SDK.

flows.title: Create an alert
steps: Go to the Alerts page and click Create Alert.
Choose the alert's sources, one or more projects or monitors, and the environments it evaluates. By default it runs across all environments.
Set the triggers that make it run, for example an issue being created. Any one of them is enough.
Set the filters that must also be true, grouped under ANY or ALL.
Add the actions to take when they match, such as a Slack notification, an email or a Jira ticket.

flows.title: Find and inspect issues
steps: Open the Issues page. Its tabs list All Unresolved, For Review, Regressed, Archived and Escalating issues.
Filter by properties such as browser, device, impacted users, or whether an error is unhandled.
For an error issue, hover over its title to see the stack trace of the latest event. Click an issue to open its Issue Details page.
To keep a query for later, use the Saved Searches button in the header.
